name: Bungei Kanojo to Boku Futari dake no Ai no Su datta Bushitsu ni Yarichin ga Nyuubu Shite Kita!
original_name: 文芸彼女と僕二人だけの愛の巣だった部室にヤリチンが入部してきた!
source:
In the literature club, Yuuto has come to be in a relationship with his senior girl Serika while those two had passed time two alone in their club activity room.

Having experienced our first kiss with my tender senior girl Serika, Yuuto expects that their relationship will be deepened... 

When he thinks like that, a womanizer, who is infamous as a sex-obsessed guy, suddenly joins the literature club.
Yuuto's anxiety isn't sensed by unsuspecting Serika. She comes close to the sex-obsessed womanizer, so that she finally falls victim to his venomous fangs...

A quiet and benevolent literary girl is made into a flesh faphole by the womanizer's selfish sex.

Please enjoy seeing the spectacular where the literary girl, who once apologized to her lover for being deflowered, gets corrupted into a femhole stained with the womanizer's color!

translation:
在文学社里，优斗和学姐芹香成为恋人，两人一直在只有彼此的社团活动室里度过时光。

和温柔的芹香学姐接吻后，优斗期待着两人的关系进一步发展……

然而，就在他这样想时，一个以沉迷性事闻名的花花公子突然加入了文学社。
毫无察觉的芹香没有发现优斗的担忧，反而靠近那个沉迷性事的花花公子，最终落入他毒牙般的陷阱……

安静温柔的文学少女被花花公子自私的性欲变成了肉便器。

请欣赏这场壮观的堕落：曾经因被恋人夺走处女而道歉的文学少女，最终被染上花花公子的颜色，沦为淫穴！
